newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INTER'S MORATTI TO MEET RONALDO'S AGENTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INTER'S MORATTI TO MEET RONALDO'S AGENTS.

text.p: Inter president Massimo Moratti said on Tuesday he would meet Ronaldo's Brazilian agents soon to discuss the Italian club's bid for the striker.
He said he was also optimistic that England's Paul Ince would stay at the serie A club.
"I will meet his (Ronaldo's) agents in the next few days, maybe even tomorrow," Moratti said in Milan.

The world footballer of the year, currently in France for a four-nation tournament, is in a tug of war between Barcelona -- his Spanish club this season -- and Inter, who are reportedly leading the bidding for him.

Moratti said he was increasingly optimistic that midfielder Ince, a big crowd favourite for his aggression and determination, would decide to stay at the club after months of indecision over his future.
"I think that in the end he will stay," he said.
